versions.subject: rules for APT32
versions.detection:
windows:
    CommandLine_lc:
        - '*Get-ChildItem*'
        - '*$_.LastAccessTime*'
        - '*$_.LastWriteTime*'
        - '*$_.CreationTime*'
linux:
    CommandLine_lc: '*touch*'
condition: linux or windows
